title: Men's Plumber – Off Duty. Not Looking at Your Sink. Hoodie

seo.title: Plumber Hoodie – Off Duty. Not Looking at Your Sink
seo.description: A funny plumber hoodie for the guy who is off duty: OFF DUTY. NOT LOOKING AT YOUR SINK. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

OFF DUTY. NOT LOOKING AT YOUR SINK. is the plumber hoodie for the guy who gets asked about every leak at every party, worn to the cookout, the lake and the lawn chair.

OFF DUTY. runs across the top in heavy capitals and NOT LOOKING AT YOUR SINK. fills the bottom, just as wide. Between them a plumber in overalls and a cap reclines in a striped lawn chair with a burger and a pipe wrench at his side while a faucet drips into a bucket behind him.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets navy and red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold morning on the job?
Yes. The Off Duty. Not Looking at Your Sink. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold early calls, crawl spaces and evenings by the grill.

How does the Off Duty. Not Looking at Your Sink. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a plumber?
It is a natural one. Every plumber has been cornered at a party about a leaky faucet, so it lands with the crew, the family and neighbors who keep asking. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the plumber sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Off Duty. Not Looking at Your Sink. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
